syndica.kernel.AgentCatalog: Registry of agent manifests (declarative and class-based) with queryable same-name overrides; `freeze` turns it into agent factories.
syndica.kernel.AgentFactory: Callable that builds one `BaseAgent` from a `HooksCenter` and an `EventBus`; what `Runtime.spawn` takes.
syndica.kernel.AgentInfo: Serializable registry entry for one agent: id, name, `agent_type`, status, parent, children, session, lease, flags and metadata.
syndica.kernel.AgentManifest: One declarative (or class-based) agent manifest; field order is part of the API and new fields are only appended.
syndica.kernel.AgentOptions: Static configuration of one agent: name, LLM, tools, system prompt, turn limit, danger judge and policy, tool concurrency.
syndica.kernel.AgentRegistry: Store protocol for agent state (`AgentInfo`) that may be shared across processes; check implementations with `AgentRegistryContract`.
syndica.kernel.AgentSlot: One slot of a topology: which role fills it, how many instances, boot and exit behaviour, extra tools, budget and isolation.
syndica.kernel.AgentStatus: Lifecycle state of an agent: idle, running, paused, waiting, aborting or zombie (zombie agents stay addressable).
syndica.kernel.AllowAll: Danger policy that lets every call through; for hosts that already sandbox elsewhere.
syndica.kernel.Anchor: One link of a re-openable reference chain (user message, file or artifact location plus the quoted text).
syndica.kernel.AnchorSource: Where an `Anchor` points: a user message, a file or an artifact.
syndica.kernel.ArtifactHandler: Protocol for format semantics of an artifact kind: preview, semantic diff and L1 validation for the `(kind, mime)` pairs it handles.
syndica.kernel.ArtifactReader: Protocol a handler reads artifact content through, by the version recorded in an `ArtifactRef`.
syndica.kernel.ArtifactRef: Reference to one version of an artifact: id, path, version, kind, mime and whether it is a deliverable.
syndica.kernel.AskUser: Tool that asks a human for free-form input and waits for the answer.
syndica.kernel.AskUserQuestion: Tool that asks a human to choose one of several options and waits for the answer.
syndica.kernel.AttributeValue: Type of a trace span attribute value.
syndica.kernel.BaseAgent: The turn loop of one agent: calls the LLM, runs tools through the executor and fires the hook junctions.
syndica.kernel.BaselineStrategy: Reference `LongHorizonStrategy`: nudges on stalls, protects core deliverables when budget runs low, restates the goal on drift, stops when the completion criteria hold.
syndica.kernel.BlockHighRisk: Default danger policy: block high-risk calls, allow everything else.
syndica.kernel.Budget: Four-dimensional budget (tokens, cost, wall clock, turns); `None` means unlimited in that dimension.
syndica.kernel.BudgetAction: What a strategy wants when budget runs low: continue (optionally with advice) or wrap up next turn.
syndica.kernel.BudgetPolicy: Budget settings of a `Runtime`: the root budget, prices, and what to do when it runs out.
syndica.kernel.BudgetView: Read-only view of one agent's budget node: limit, used (including descendants), remaining and exhausted dimensions.
syndica.kernel.CachePrefixProvider: Protocol an LLM implements to expose the exact ordered request units it caches on, for prefix-drift detection.
syndica.kernel.CausalityEdge: Causal link between two trace spans (spawn, message and other `EdgeKind`s).
syndica.kernel.ConfigError: Raised when a value the caller supplied is invalid: configuration, a declaration, or an argument to a public API. Fix the value and call again.
syndica.kernel.Confirmation: Waiter for a human's confirmation of one tool call.
syndica.kernel.ConfirmationHandler: Protocol for the host-selected transport that delivers one confirmation request and returns the decision.
syndica.kernel.ConfirmationOutcome: One human decision on one confirmation request.
syndica.kernel.ConfirmationRequest: Immutable snapshot of one request for human confirmation of a tool call.
syndica.kernel.Context: An agent's conversation state: the current trajectory of `ContextBlock`s plus stop reason and bookkeeping.
syndica.kernel.ContextBlock: One block of a trajectory (system, user, assistant or tool) with its trust level.
syndica.kernel.ContextOverflowError: Raised by an LLM when a request exceeds the context window; triggers the `context_overflow` junction.
syndica.kernel.ContractViolation: Raised when a documented protocol or caller contract is broken: the value is fine but the call is not allowed now, or an implementation broke a protocol's promise.
syndica.kernel.DEFAULT_RULES: The built-in danger rules the default `DangerJudge` applies.
syndica.kernel.DangerJudge: Pure, stateless judge that matches a tool call against a rule table and returns a `DangerVerdict`.
syndica.kernel.DangerPolicy: Protocol that turns a `DangerVerdict` into a `Disposition` (block, allow, or ask a human).
syndica.kernel.DangerRequest: What a `DangerPolicy` receives for one call: the verdict, the call and its provenance.
syndica.kernel.DangerRule: One danger rule; `matches` is a pure function of the command text.
syndica.kernel.DangerVerdict: Result of judging one call: rule id, risk level and reason.
syndica.kernel.DeliveryResult: Structured outcome of `Runtime.send`; delivery failures are returned, not raised.
syndica.kernel.Diff: Semantic difference between two artifact versions, with a human-readable summary.
syndica.kernel.Disposition: How a policy disposes of a call: allow, block or ask for confirmation.
syndica.kernel.DriftAction: What a strategy wants after goal drift is confirmed: continue, or have the original goal re-injected.
syndica.kernel.DriftReport: Result of the latest goal-drift check over a window of turns.
syndica.kernel.EdgeKind: Kinds of causality edges between trace spans.
syndica.kernel.Event: One record published on the `EventBus`: kind, agent id, payload and sequence.
syndica.kernel.EventBus: In-process event bus with a bounded buffer per subscriber.
syndica.kernel.ExecResult: Result of one command run through a `Portal`.
syndica.kernel.Exhaustion: What happens when a budget runs out (graceful wrap-up by default).
syndica.kernel.ExitMode: Where an agent goes after a unit of work: stay idle, become a zombie (default), or exit.
syndica.kernel.ExtensionJunction: Handle of a Module-owned extension junction (`<module>:<event>`), declared in the Module manifest.
syndica.kernel.ExternalCallPolicy: Judge, policy, guard and confirmation used by `call_external` for one external call.
syndica.kernel.FileSessionStore: `SessionStore` that keeps sessions as files under a directory.
syndica.kernel.FileStat: Version, size and executable bit of one workspace file.
syndica.kernel.FileTaint: Tracks which workspace files were written from untrusted content, relative to a baseline.
syndica.kernel.FileTraceStore: `TraceStore` that keeps traces as files under a directory.
syndica.kernel.Finding: One hit of the redactor's commit gate: line number and rule id, never the secret itself.
syndica.kernel.FlagDeclaration: Declaration of one Flag (key, default, description, choices, bounds) consumed by code, settings UI and docs.
syndica.kernel.FlagRow: One row of the Flag reference: key, owning Module, type, default, choices, bounds and description.
syndica.kernel.FlagValue: Type of a Flag value: `bool`, `int` or `str`.
syndica.kernel.Goal: The authoritative statement of what the user wants, with anchors back to the user's words and its trust level.
syndica.kernel.GrepHit: One match of a workspace text search: relative path, line number and line.
syndica.kernel.HookCallback: Type of a hook callback registered on a junction.
syndica.kernel.HookResult: A hook's opinion on one operation: skip it, replace its result, modify its arguments, add history, or mark it untrusted.
syndica.kernel.HooksCenter: Dispatch centre for hook junctions; kernel junctions and declared extension junctions.
syndica.kernel.HostFacts: Static facts about the host (OS, platform, shell) that may appear in a system prompt.
syndica.kernel.HumanInteractionModule: Runtime Module that installs `AskUser` and `AskUserQuestion` for every agent.
syndica.kernel.IdSource: Protocol that hands out ids by stable key; inject one into `Runtime` for reproducible ids.
syndica.kernel.Junction: The kernel's hook junctions (spawn, turn, tool, LLM, artifact and more).
syndica.kernel.JunctionKind: Dispatch semantics of an extension junction: interceptable or observable.
syndica.kernel.JunctionRef: A kernel `Junction` or the name of an extension junction.
syndica.kernel.LLM: Protocol a model backend implements: one request in, one reply out.
syndica.kernel.LLMConfig: Configuration of one LLM call; provider and model decide the cache key and billing.
syndica.kernel.LLMResponseError: Raised when an LLM reply cannot be used as a valid result.
syndica.kernel.LocalIsolator: Isolation for a local workspace: per-agent copies and their three-way merge back.
syndica.kernel.LocalWorkspace: Local `Workspace`: root, shell and subprocess environment are supplied by the host.
syndica.kernel.LongHorizonContext: Read-only snapshot a `LongHorizonStrategy` decides from: goal, rubrics, progress, budget, stalls, drift and the latest verdict.
syndica.kernel.LongHorizonStrategy: Protocol for a long-run paradigm: how to react to stalls, low budget and goal drift, and when to stop. Check implementations with `LongHorizonStrategyContract`.
syndica.kernel.MESSAGE_LIMIT: Maximum length of the text a `LongHorizonStrategy` action may return; it enters the history.
syndica.kernel.MailboxConfirmationHandler: `ConfirmationHandler` that publishes a request event and waits for one trusted human reply in the agent's mailbox.
syndica.kernel.ManifestSource: Where a manifest came from (mapping, file, directory, built-in or class).
syndica.kernel.MergeConflict: One file that could not be merged back from an isolated copy.
syndica.kernel.MergeReport: Result of merging an isolated copy back: merged files and conflicts.
syndica.kernel.Message: One message between agents or from the host, with trigger, correlation id and trust level.
syndica.kernel.MessageBroker: Store protocol for agent mailboxes; check implementations with `MessageBrokerContract`.
syndica.kernel.MissingQueueCallback: Callback a `MessageBroker` invokes when a message is published to an agent without a mailbox.
syndica.kernel.ModuleHost: What the host hands a third-party Module factory: workspace root, the allow-listed environment and the redactor.
syndica.kernel.NO_RULE_MATCHED: The `DangerVerdict` returned when no rule matched; it means the rules did not recognise the call, not that it is safe.
syndica.kernel.Orchestrator: Built-in class-based role that delegates work to Planner, Explorer and Worker and never edits files itself.
syndica.kernel.OutcomeKind: Verdict on one rubric: satisfied, unmet (with evidence), unconfirmed, or needs a human.
syndica.kernel.OverrideRecord: Snapshot left behind when a manifest is overridden by name.
syndica.kernel.PayloadRef: Reference to a free-text payload stored by a `TraceStore` (sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes).
syndica.kernel.PayloadRefused: Raised by a `TraceStore` that cannot accept one payload (too large) while the store itself is healthy.
syndica.kernel.PayloadText: Scenario-document reference to a payload stored next to the trace.
syndica.kernel.Plugin: Protocol for a Runtime-level plugin: a name and a `register(hooks)` method.
syndica.kernel.Portal: Protocol for file and process operations on a workspace; implementations reject paths outside it.
syndica.kernel.PrefixDriftModule: Runtime Module that records prefix-cache drift between consecutive requests of each agent.
syndica.kernel.PrefixDriftRecord: One recorded prefix drift: which request unit changed and its digests before and after.
syndica.kernel.PrefixDriftService: Runtime service holding each agent's request baseline and its drift records.
syndica.kernel.Preview: A readable rendering of an artifact version.
syndica.kernel.PriceTable: Protocol that prices a model's tokens.
syndica.kernel.Prices: Per-million-token prices of one model: input, output and cached input.
syndica.kernel.ProgressSnapshot: Latest measured progress: satisfied and mandatory rubric ids, rubrics waiting for a human, and the turn it was measured on.
syndica.kernel.PtyCapture: Output read from an agent's terminal session.
syndica.kernel.PtyStatus: State of a terminal session without its output.
syndica.kernel.RedactedContent: Trajectory content whose every leaf has been redacted; produced only by `redacted_content`.
syndica.kernel.RedactedSessionRecord: A `SessionRecord` whose content has been redacted; produced only by `redacted_record`.
syndica.kernel.RedactedText: Canonical JSON text whose every string leaf has been redacted; produced only by the kernel's redaction functions.
syndica.kernel.RedactionRule: A user-supplied redaction rule (`custom.*` id and a regular expression).
syndica.kernel.Redactor: Protocol for the redactor: `redact` replaces secrets idempotently, `scan` reports findings for the commit gate.
syndica.kernel.Reply: Waiter for a reply to one specific request, matched by correlation id.
syndica.kernel.RetryModule: Runtime Module that retries failed LLM calls with backoff and optional fallbacks.
syndica.kernel.RiskLevel: Risk level of a danger verdict.
syndica.kernel.Role: Role of a context block: system, user, assistant or tool.
syndica.kernel.Rubric: One checkable projection of the `Goal`, anchored back to it; mandatory or optional, checkable or judgment.
syndica.kernel.RubricKind: Whether a rubric can be checked automatically or needs human judgment.
syndica.kernel.RubricOrigin: Where a rubric came from: projected from the goal, or human feedback.
syndica.kernel.RubricOutcome: The acceptance outcome for one rubric, with evidence anchors.
syndica.kernel.RubricStatus: Whether a rubric is active or only proposed.
syndica.kernel.RuleRedactor: The kernel's `Redactor`: built-in rules plus user rules and literal secret values.
syndica.kernel.Runtime: Drives agent lifecycles: spawn, kill, pause, resume, abort, send, wait, addressing and topology assembly.
syndica.kernel.RuntimeModule: Self-contained Runtime capability with Flags: plugins, tools, services, lifecycle hooks, junctions and artifact handlers, plus a manifest for review.
syndica.kernel.SafetyModule: Built-in Module declaring the wait wall-clock limit and the handling of untrusted high-risk calls.
syndica.kernel.ScenarioDocument: Validated, immutable scenario document (a captured or hand-written run that can be replayed).
syndica.kernel.ScriptedLLM: LLM test double that replays scripted turns in order.
syndica.kernel.ScriptedTurn: One scripted reply of a `ScriptedLLM`: content, tool calls or an exception to raise.
syndica.kernel.SessionBudget: Additive budget limits and usage stored with a session.
syndica.kernel.SessionMeta: Session metadata readable without loading its content.
syndica.kernel.SessionRecord: All serializable state of one session: metadata, the root agent's trajectory, prefix snapshot and flags.
syndica.kernel.SessionStatus: Whether a session is active or an archived copy.
syndica.kernel.SessionStore: Store protocol for persisted sessions; check implementations with `SessionStoreContract`.
syndica.kernel.Span: One unit of traced work with start, end, attributes and status.
syndica.kernel.SpanEvent: A point in time recorded on a span.
syndica.kernel.SpanKind: Kinds of trace spans (agent, turn, LLM call, tool call, module and more).
syndica.kernel.SpanStatus: Outcome of a span or a whole trace.
syndica.kernel.StableKey: Type of the stable key an `IdSource` derives ids from.
syndica.kernel.StallAction: What a strategy wants when progress stalls: continue, or nudge the agent with a message.
syndica.kernel.StaticPrices: `PriceTable` looked up by model name, optionally falling back to another table.
syndica.kernel.StopDecision: Whether a strategy wants the agent to stop, and why.
syndica.kernel.Subscription: One subscription to the `EventBus` with its own buffer and drop counter.
syndica.kernel.SyndicaError: Base class of Syndica's errors; every instance carries `expected`, `received` and `next_action`.
syndica.kernel.Tool: Base class for tools; the JSON schema is derived from `execute`'s signature and docstring.
syndica.kernel.ToolCall: One tool call requested by the model: id, tool name and JSON arguments.
syndica.kernel.ToolFatalError: Raised by a tool for errors that cannot succeed on retry; it propagates to the agent loop instead of becoming model-visible output.
syndica.kernel.ToolResult: Result of one tool call: output, trust level, metadata and artifacts.
syndica.kernel.Topology: A set of agent slots; slot names are unique and at most one is the root.
syndica.kernel.TraceHeader: Header of one trace: id, level, source, redaction rules, start and end.
syndica.kernel.TraceLevel: What a trace records: structure only, plus a replay document, or full requests.
syndica.kernel.TraceRecorder: `Tracer` that records one run as a trace in a `TraceStore`.
syndica.kernel.TraceRedaction: The redaction rule set a trace was recorded with.
syndica.kernel.TraceSource: Where a trace came from: arguments, config digest, Syndica version and git commit.
syndica.kernel.TraceStore: Store protocol for traces; check implementations with `TraceStoreContract`.
syndica.kernel.Tracer: Protocol that receives the kernel's instrumentation (spans, events, edges, LLM exchanges, tool results).
syndica.kernel.Trigger: When a message is consumed: before the receiver's next turn (pending, default) or after its whole unit of work ends (deferred).
syndica.kernel.TrustLevel: Whether content is trusted; untrusted content must stay marked through everything derived from it.
syndica.kernel.Usage: Consumption: token counts by tier, cost, turns, and whether any count is estimated.
syndica.kernel.UserInput: Waiter for free-form input from a human.
syndica.kernel.Verdict: The four-valued acceptance verdict (pass, partial, block, unverified) with per-rubric outcomes; build it with `derive_verdict`.
syndica.kernel.VerdictStatus: The four verdict values: pass, partial, block, unverified.
syndica.kernel.VersionEntry: One change of one file in a workspace's version layer.
syndica.kernel.VersionStore: A workspace's version layer: content-addressed history of file changes.
syndica.kernel.Violation: One L1 format violation reported by an artifact handler, with an optional anchor.
syndica.kernel.WaitResult: Outcome of one wait: its state and the message that answered it.
syndica.kernel.WaitState: How a wait ended: answered, timeout, preempted or aborted.
syndica.kernel.Waiter: Sealed base of the things an agent can wait for (`UserInput`, `Confirmation`, `Reply`).
syndica.kernel.Workspace: Protocol for the workspace a host hands the runtime; gives out `Portal`s.
syndica.kernel.WorkspaceRouter: A Runtime's workspace router; routes each agent's file and process operations to its workspace or isolated copy.
syndica.kernel.WriteConflict: Raised by a versioned write when the file is no longer at the version the caller expected.
syndica.kernel.call_external: Run one external tool call through judge, guard and policy, under untrusted provenance, and trace it.
syndica.kernel.derive_verdict: Derive the four-valued `Verdict` from rubrics and per-rubric outcomes; the only sanctioned way to build one.
syndica.kernel.encode_redacted: Redact every string leaf of a JSON-like value and encode it as canonical JSON (`RedactedText`).
syndica.kernel.flag_reference: All Flags the given Modules declare, in assembly order, as `FlagRow`s.
syndica.kernel.local_tools: The local file and shell tools bound to a `Portal`, keyed by tool name.
syndica.kernel.orchestration_tools: The orchestration tools (Delegate, Fork, SendMessage, QueryAgent, KillAgent) for one agent, keyed by tool name.
syndica.kernel.parse_scenario_document: Validate a scenario document mapping and return an immutable `ScenarioDocument`.
syndica.kernel.redacted_content: Redact a trajectory segment leaf by leaf and return it as `RedactedContent`.
syndica.kernel.redacted_record: Redact a `SessionRecord`'s content and return it as `RedactedSessionRecord`.
syndica.kernel.register_builtins: Register the built-in roles (Planner, Explorer, Worker, Orchestrator) into an `AgentCatalog`.
syndica.kernel.verbatim_attribute: Whether a trace attribute holds a kernel-generated identifier, digest, payload reference or closed-set value that is recorded without redaction.

syndica.kernel.contracts.AgentRegistryContract: Conformance suite every `AgentRegistry` implementation must pass; subclass it and provide a `registry` fixture.
syndica.kernel.contracts.ContractSuite: Base class of the conformance suites; also guards that async cases are actually run.
syndica.kernel.contracts.LongHorizonStrategyContract: Conformance suite every `LongHorizonStrategy` must pass; subclass it and provide a `strategy` fixture.
syndica.kernel.contracts.MessageBrokerContract: Conformance suite every `MessageBroker` implementation must pass; subclass it and provide a `broker` fixture.
syndica.kernel.contracts.SessionStoreContract: Conformance suite every `SessionStore` implementation must pass; subclass it and provide a `store` fixture.
syndica.kernel.contracts.TraceStoreContract: Conformance suite every `TraceStore` implementation must pass; subclass it and provide a `store` fixture.
syndica.kernel.contracts.UPDATE_PROTECTED_FIELD_OWNERS: For each protected `AgentInfo` field, the operation that owns writing it.
syndica.kernel.contracts.WorkspaceContract: Conformance suite every `Workspace` backend must pass; subclass it and provide a `workspace` fixture.

syndica.runner.Divergence: One place where a replay diverged from the recorded run.
syndica.runner.ReplayResult: Result of a replay: divergences (empty when the run was reproduced), the scenario result and unrebuilt Modules.
syndica.runner.ReplayRunner: Replays a captured scenario document against the real runtime with a scripted model.
syndica.runner.Scenario: A parsed v1 declarative scenario: catalog, agents, topology, prompt, scripted responses and expectations.
syndica.runner.ScenarioAgent: One agent of a v1 scenario: its manifest and the scripted turns of each instance.
syndica.runner.ScenarioEvent: One event observed while running a scenario.
syndica.runner.ScenarioExpectation: What a scenario expects; only the specified items are compared.
syndica.runner.ScenarioMismatch: Raised when a scenario ran but did not meet its declared expectation.
syndica.runner.ScenarioResponse: One scripted human answer in a v1 scenario.
syndica.runner.ScenarioResult: What running a scenario produced: outputs, tool order, stop reasons, errors, statuses, events and workspace.
syndica.runner.ScenarioRunner: Runs one validated v1 scenario and asserts its declared result.
syndica.runner.load_document: Read a scenario document from a YAML or JSON file and validate it.
syndica.runner.load_scenario: Parse one v1 scenario file without importing any backend.

syndica.backends.llm_openai.FreeTierPrices: `PriceTable` for OpenRouter free models: free ones cost 0, others are unknown.
syndica.backends.llm_openai.OpenAICompatible: `LLM` that calls a model endpoint speaking the OpenAI chat/completions protocol.
syndica.backends.llm_openai.ProviderHTTPError: Raised when the endpoint answers with an HTTP error status.
syndica.backends.llm_openai.recoverable: Whether a failure may resolve on its own after waiting (rate limits, transient server errors).
syndica.backends.llm_openai.retry_after: The earliest retry delay in seconds the endpoint asked for, or `None`.

syndica.backends.llm_router.BackoffPolicy: Per-platform exponential backoff settings of a `ModelRouter`.
syndica.backends.llm_router.MemberHealth: Health snapshot of one platform in a `ModelRouter`.
syndica.backends.llm_router.ModelRouter: `LLM` that rotates across several platforms in declared order, backing each off independently on failure.

syndica.backends.otel_otlp.OtlpExportError: Raised when the collector did not accept an export; `resendable` says whether resending is safe.
syndica.backends.otel_otlp.OtlpHttpExporter: Exports a stored trace to an OTLP/HTTP JSON traces endpoint.
syndica.backends.otel_otlp.otlp_documents: Render one stored trace as OTLP/HTTP JSON request bodies, in batches.

syndica.backends.trl.dry_run: Load an exported SFT dataset into TRL's `SFTTrainer` with a tiny local model, without downloading one.
syndica.backends.trl.dry_run_preference: Load an exported preference dataset into TRL's `DPOTrainer` with a tiny local model, without downloading one.

syndica.kernel.events.KERNEL_EVENTS: Every event kind the kernel publishes, with the payload keys it always carries.

syndica.kernel.file_taint.TaintAware: Protocol of a `Portal` that knows file taint; file tools use it to mark what they read.

syndica.kernel.isolation.IsolatedCopy: One agent's isolated copy of the workspace, with the file versions it started from.

syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.DangerPolicySpec: Scenario-document record of a per-role danger policy.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.DangerRuleSpec: Scenario-document record of one danger rule and its parameters.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.FrozenRole: Scenario-document record of a frozen role: interpolated system prompt and tools in order.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.GateRecord: Scenario-document record of one danger-gate decision.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.HostAction: Scenario-document record of a host action (abort, interrupt, shutdown).
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.HostProfile: Scenario-document record of how the host assembled the Runtime.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ModuleRecord: Scenario-document record of a third-party Module: distribution, version and flags.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.SCENARIO_EVENT_KINDS: Event kinds a scenario's `expect.events` may compare.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioCall: Scenario-document record of one tool call the model made.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioEntry: Scenario-document record of how the run started (slot, query or send).
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioError: Scenario-document record of a typed failure.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioExpectation: What a scenario expects; only the specified items are compared.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioInstance: Scenario-document record of one runtime instance of a role.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioReply: Scenario-document record of one model reply (or the exception it raised).
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioResponse: Scenario-document record of one human answer.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioRole: Scenario-document record of a role: a manifest or a frozen role.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ScenarioSource: Scenario-document record of where it was captured: trace id, arguments, config digest, version, commit.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.SkippedCall: Scenario-document record of a call skipped by a `pre_tool_use` hook.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.Text: Text in a scenario document: inline, or a `PayloadText` reference.
syndica.kernel.scenario_schema.ToolOutcome: Scenario-document record of what a tool call returned or raised before hooks rewrote it.

syndica.kernel.tool_executor.ToolOutcomeObserver: Callback that observes every tool call's outcome, including calls a hook cut short.

syndica.kernel.trace.ATTRIBUTE_DOMAINS: Closed value sets of the trace attributes that have them.
syndica.kernel.trace.ATTRIBUTE_KINDS: The type of every trace attribute the kernel records.
syndica.kernel.trace.TRACE_SCHEMA: Schema identifier written into every trace header.

syndica.kernel.workspace.ANY: Write precondition that skips the version check.
syndica.kernel.workspace.Expected: Type of a write precondition: `ANY` (no check), a version string (must match), or `None` (file must not exist).
